remaining_concerns: Much of the negative evidence concerns state responsibility by omission, tolerance, or emergency-rule abuse rather than direct presidential orders.
Eastern-conflict sources overlap heavily across displacement, civilian harm, and protection failures, so the retained set prioritizes synthesis over incident-by-incident repetition.
Press-freedom and protest-repression evidence is strong but still fragmented across multiple incidents and mixed attribution.
